# Rise and Battle the Day
## Scripture
"Have I not commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Do not be frightened, and do not be dismayed, for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go." – Joshua 1:9
## Reflection
Every morning you wake up, a battle is already waiting. Not against flesh and blood, but against complacency, distraction, and the quiet pull to coast through another day. Joshua stood at the edge of the promised land facing giants, walled cities, and his own fear. God's answer wasn't a pep talk—it was a command rooted in His presence: "Be strong and courageous... for the LORD your God is with you."

Strength isn't the absence of fear; it's obedience in the presence of it. Courage isn't loud—it's the quiet decision to show up, do the hard thing, and trust that God goes before you. Too many men drift because they wait to feel ready. Warriors move because they've been commanded and accompanied.

Today, you'll face a moment that demands a choice: take the easy road or the right one. Lead your family. Keep your word. Fight the sin you've been entertaining. You don't fight alone—the God of Joshua marches with you. So strap in, brother. Rise and battle the day.
## Daily Challenge
Do 25 pushups, and at the top of each rep, say aloud: "God is with me." Then take on the hardest task on your list before noon.
